prompt: An IR signal just LEFT of 3000 cm⁻¹ (around 3000–3100) indicates:

options.label: sp² C–H bonds (vinyl or aromatic C-H)
O–H stretch of alcohols (sharpened by H-bonding)

explanation: sp² C-H sits just ABOVE 3000 (vinyl/aromatic). sp³ C-H sits just BELOW 3000 (alkyl). sp C-H (terminal alkyne) is way higher at ~3300. O-H is above 3200 (broad). The 3000 cm⁻¹ 'dividing line' is a quick way to spot sp² character in an unknown.
